description:
​Project Overview:
Pasargad is a physical model of a traditional dhow featuring an integrated camera system for coastal and environmental monitoring. It bridges traditional maritime heritage with modern surveillance technology to observe aquatic ecosystems. Designed as a foundational hardware model, it holds scalable potential for automated data collection and AI-driven image processing inspired by NASA's Earth observation missions.
